answer: Tiered reputation makes Sybil attacks expensive: every new agent starts in the quartz tier with near-zero spending limits and must earn its way up through sustained honest work — weeks of verified transactions to reach onyx, months of consistent behavior for opal. Each tier requires a refundable stake that is slashed on fraud, so one attacker running a hundred fake identities must fund and age a hundred separate stakes. The cost scales with the attack, while a single honest agent pays it once.
